dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Slightly concave trailing edge spline curvature from the posterior ridge to the apex.

dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Vertical height to base width ratio of approximately 1:1.6.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse angle at the pixel coordinate marking the melon-rostrum transition.
